```diff
+ /**
+  * Type definitions for Exa SDK
+  */
+ 
+ // Search types
+ export type SearchType = "auto" | "neural" | "keyword";
+ 
+ export interface SearchOptions {
+ 	numResults?: number;
+ 	type?: SearchType;
+ 	includeDomains?: string[];
+ 	excludeDomains?: string[];
+ 	category?: string;
+ 	startPublishedDate?: string;
+ 	endPublishedDate?: string;
+ 	includeText?: string[];
+ 	excludeText?: string[];
+ }
+ 
+ export interface TextOptions {
+ 	maxCharacters?: number;
+ 	includeHtmlTags?: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface HighlightOptions {
+ 	highlightsPerUrl?: number;
+ 	numSentences?: number;
+ 	query?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface ContentOptions {
+ 	text?: boolean | TextOptions;
+ 	highlights?: boolean | HighlightOptions;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface SearchAndContentsOptions
+ 	extends SearchOptions,
+ 		ContentOptions {}
+ 
+ // Find Similar types
+ export interface FindSimilarOptions {
+ 	numResults?: number;
+ 	excludeSourceDomain?: boolean;
+ 	includeDomains?: string[];
+ 	excludeDomains?: string[];
+ }
+ 
+ export interface FindSimilarAndContentsOptions
+ 	extends FindSimilarOptions,
+ 		ContentOptions {}
+ 
+ // Contents retrieval types
+ export interface ContentsOptions extends ContentOptions {
+ 	summary?: {
+ 		query?: string;
+ 		schema?: object;
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
+ // Answer types
+ export interface AnswerOptions {
+ 	model?: "exa" | "exa-pro";
+ 	stream?: boolean;
+ 	text?: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ // Result types
+ export interface BaseResult {
+ 	url: string;
+ 	id: string;
+ 	title: string | null;
+ 	score?: number;
+ 	publishedDate?: string;
+ 	author?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface SearchResult extends BaseResult {}
+ 
+ export interface SearchResponse {
+ 	results: SearchResult[];
+ 	autopromptString?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface ContentResult extends BaseResult {
+ 	text?: string;
+ 	highlights?: string[];
+ 	highlightScores?: number[];
+ 	summary?: string | object;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface ContentsResponse {
+ 	results: ContentResult[];
+ }
+ 
+ export interface Citation {
+ 	id: string;
+ 	url: string;
+ 	title: string;
+ 	author?: string;
+ 	publishedDate?: string;
+ 	text?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export interface AnswerResponse {
+ 	answer: string;
+ 	citations: Citation[];
+ }
+ 
+ export interface StreamChunk {
+ 	content?: string;
+ 	citations?: Citation[];
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ import { EXA_CLIENT } from "@/lib/exa/client";
+ import type {
+ 	SearchOptions,
+ 	SearchAndContentsOptions,
+ 	FindSimilarOptions,
+ 	FindSimilarAndContentsOptions,
+ 	ContentsOptions,
+ 	AnswerOptions,
+ 	SearchResponse,
+ 	ContentsResponse,
+ 	AnswerResponse,
+ 	StreamChunk,
+ } from "@/lib/exa/types";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Search for relevant web content based on a query
+  * @param query The search query
+  * @param options Search options
+  * @returns Search results
+  * @example
+  * await search("latest advancements in quantum computing", { numResults: 10 })
+  */
+ export const search = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: SearchOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;SearchResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	return await EXA_CLIENT.search(query, options);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Search for web content and retrieve their contents
+  * @param query The search query
+  * @param options Search and content options
+  * @returns Search results with content
+  * @example
+  * await searchAndContents("AI in healthcare", { text: true, highlights: true, numResults: 5 })
+  */
+ export const searchAndContents = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: SearchAndContentsOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;ContentsResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	return await EXA_CLIENT.searchAndContents(query, options);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Find web pages similar to a reference URL
+  * @param url Reference URL
+  * @param options Find similar options
+  * @returns Similar web pages
+  * @example
+  * await findSimilar("https://example.com/article", { numResults: 5, excludeSourceDomain: true })
+  */
+ export const findSimilar = async (
+ 	url: string,
+ 	options: FindSimilarOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;SearchResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	return await EXA_CLIENT.findSimilar(url, options);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Find web pages similar to a reference URL and retrieve their contents
+  * @param url Reference URL
+  * @param options Find similar and content options
+  * @returns Similar web pages with content
+  * @example
+  * await findSimilarAndContents("https://example.com/article", { text: true, highlights: true, numResults: 5 })
+  */
+ export const findSimilarAndContents = async (
+ 	url: string,
+ 	options: FindSimilarAndContentsOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;ContentsResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	return await EXA_CLIENT.findSimilarAndContents(url, options);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Retrieve contents from one or more URLs
+  * @param urls URL or array of URLs to get content for
+  * @param options Content retrieval options
+  * @returns Content from the URLs
+  * @example
+  * await getContents(["https://example.com/article1", "https://example.com/article2"], { text: true, highlights: true })
+  */
+ export const getContents = async (
+ 	urls: string | string[],
+ 	options: ContentsOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;ContentsResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	return await EXA_CLIENT.getContents(urls, options);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Generate an answer to a question using web content
+  * @param query The question to answer
+  * @param options Answer options
+  * @returns Answer with citations
+  * @example
+  * await answer("What is the latest valuation of SpaceX?", { text: true })
+  */
+ export const answer = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: AnswerOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;AnswerResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	return await EXA_CLIENT.answer(query, options);
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Stream an answer to a question using web content
+  * @param query The question to answer
+  * @param options Answer options
+  * @returns Async generator that yields answer chunks
+  * @example
+  * for await (const chunk of streamAnswer("Explain quantum computing")) {
+  *   console.log(chunk.content);
+  * }
+  */
+ export const streamAnswer = async function* (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: AnswerOptions = {},
+ ): AsyncGenerator&lt;StreamChunk&gt; {
+ 	yield* EXA_CLIENT.streamAnswer(query, { ...options, stream: true });
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Enhanced semantic search with improved error handling
+  * @param query The search query
+  * @param options Search options
+  * @returns Search results or empty array on error
+  */
+ export const enhancedSearch = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: SearchOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;SearchResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	try {
+ 		return await search(query, options);
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error performing Exa search:", error);
+ 		return { results: [] };
+ 	}
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Enhanced answer generation with fallback strategy
+  * @param query The question to answer
+  * @param options Answer options
+  * @returns Answer with citations or error message
+  */
+ export const enhancedAnswer = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: AnswerOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;AnswerResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	try {
+ 		return await answer(query, options);
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error generating Exa answer:", error);
+ 		return {
+ 			answer: "Unable to generate an answer at this time.",
+ 			citations: [],
+ 		};
+ 	}
+ };
+
```

```diff
+ import {
+ 	search,
+ 	searchAndContents,
+ 	findSimilar,
+ 	findSimilarAndContents,
+ } from "@/lib/exa/api";
+ import type {
+ 	SearchOptions,
+ 	SearchAndContentsOptions,
+ 	FindSimilarOptions,
+ 	FindSimilarAndContentsOptions,
+ 	SearchResponse,
+ 	ContentsResponse,
+ } from "@/lib/exa/types";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Perform a specialized research search with optimized parameters
+  * @param query The research query
+  * @param options Additional search options
+  * @returns Search results
+  */
+ export const researchSearch = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	options: SearchOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;SearchResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	return await search(query, {
+ 		numResults: 15,
+ 		type: "neural",
+ 		...options,
+ 	});
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Search for academic content with date filtering
+  * @param query The academic query
+  * @param startYear Starting year for publications
+  * @param options Additional search options
+  * @returns Search results with content
+  */
+ export const academicSearch = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	startYear = 2018,
+ 	options: SearchAndContentsOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;ContentsResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	const startDate = &#96;${startYear}-01-01&#96;;
+ 
+ 	return await searchAndContents(query, {
+ 		numResults: 10,
+ 		startPublishedDate: startDate,
+ 		category: "research paper",
+ 		text: true,
+ 		highlights: true,
+ 		...options,
+ 	});
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Find similar content to a reference URL with enhanced content retrieval
+  * @param url Reference URL
+  * @param options Additional find similar options
+  * @returns Similar content with text and highlights
+  */
+ export const findRelatedContent = async (
+ 	url: string,
+ 	options: FindSimilarAndContentsOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;ContentsResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	return await findSimilarAndContents(url, {
+ 		numResults: 8,
+ 		excludeSourceDomain: true,
+ 		text: true,
+ 		highlights: {
+ 			highlightsPerUrl: 3,
+ 			numSentences: 2,
+ 		},
+ 		...options,
+ 	});
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Search for news articles on a topic with date constraints
+  * @param topic The news topic
+  * @param daysBack Number of days to look back
+  * @param options Additional search options
+  * @returns Recent news articles
+  */
+ export const newsSearch = async (
+ 	topic: string,
+ 	daysBack = 30,
+ 	options: SearchOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;SearchResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	const endDate = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
+ 	const startDate = new Date(Date.now() - daysBack * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)
+ 		.toISOString()
+ 		.split("T")[0];
+ 
+ 	return await search(topic, {
+ 		numResults: 10,
+ 		category: "news",
+ 		startPublishedDate: startDate,
+ 		endPublishedDate: endDate,
+ 		...options,
+ 	});
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Perform a continuation search to find content that follows logically from an existing text
+  * @param existingText Text to find continuations for
+  * @param options Additional search options
+  * @returns Content that continues the existing text
+  */
+ export const continuationSearch = async (
+ 	existingText: string,
+ 	options: SearchOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;SearchResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	const continuationQuery = &#96;${existingText} If you found the above interesting, here's another useful resource to read:&#96;;
+ 
+ 	return await search(continuationQuery, {
+ 		type: "neural",
+ 		numResults: 5,
+ 		...options,
+ 	});
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Search for content that includes specific phrases
+  * @param query Main search query
+  * @param requiredPhrases Phrases that must be included in results
+  * @param options Additional search options
+  * @returns Filtered search results
+  */
+ export const phraseFilteredSearch = async (
+ 	query: string,
+ 	requiredPhrases: string[],
+ 	options: SearchOptions = {},
+ ): Promise&lt;SearchResponse&gt; =&gt; {
+ 	return await search(query, {
+ 		type: "neural",
+ 		numResults: 10,
+ 		includeText: requiredPhrases,
+ 		...options,
+ 	});
+ };
+
```

```diff
+ # Exa SDK Integration
+ 
+ This library provides a seamless integration with the Exa API, a powerful search and retrieval service for finding, analyzing, and extracting information from web content.
+ 
+ ## Features
+ 
+ - ✅ **Semantic Search**: Find relevant web content based on complex queries
+ - ✅ **Content Discovery**: Find similar content to a reference URL
+ - ✅ **Content Retrieval**: Extract web content with text, highlights, and summaries
+ - ✅ **Question Answering**: Generate answers with citations from web sources
+ 
+ ## Usage
+ 
+ ### Basic Search
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { search } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ const results = await search("latest advancements in quantum computing", {
+   numResults: 10,
+   type: "neural"
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Search with Content Retrieval
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { searchAndContents } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ const results = await searchAndContents("AI in healthcare", {
+   text: true,
+   highlights: true,
+   numResults: 5
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Find Similar Content
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { findSimilar, findSimilarAndContents } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ // Basic similar content search
+ const similarResults = await findSimilar("https://example.com/article", {
+   numResults: 5,
+   excludeSourceDomain: true
+ });
+ 
+ // Similar content with text and highlights
+ const similarWithContent = await findSimilarAndContents("https://example.com/article", {
+   text: true,
+   highlights: true,
+   numResults: 5
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Content Retrieval
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { getContents } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ // Get content from multiple URLs
+ const content = await getContents([
+   "https://example.com/article1",
+   "https://example.com/article2"
+ ], {
+   text: true,
+   highlights: {
+     highlightsPerUrl: 3,
+     numSentences: 2
+   }
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Question Answering
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { answer, streamAnswer } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ // Get a complete answer
+ const answerResult = await answer("What is the latest valuation of SpaceX?", {
+   text: true
+ });
+ 
+ // Stream an answer for progressive rendering
+ for await (const chunk of streamAnswer("Explain quantum computing")) {
+   if (chunk.content) {
+     console.log(chunk.content);
+   }
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Specialized Search Functions
+ 
+ The library provides several specialized search functions for common use cases:
+ 
+ ### Academic Search
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { academicSearch } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ const academicResults = await academicSearch(
+   "CRISPR gene editing applications",
+   2020 // only include papers from 2020 onwards
+ );
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### News Search
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { newsSearch } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ const newsResults = await newsSearch(
+   "cryptocurrency regulation",
+   14 // only include news from the last 14 days
+ );
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Related Content
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { findRelatedContent } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ const relatedContent = await findRelatedContent("https://example.com/article");
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Continuation Search
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { continuationSearch } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ const existingText = &#96;The impact of climate change on global agriculture has been significant.
+ Rising temperatures and changing precipitation patterns have led to shifts
+ in crop yields and growing seasons.&#96;;
+ 
+ const continuations = await continuationSearch(existingText);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Error Handling
+ 
+ The library provides enhanced versions of core functions with built-in error handling:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { enhancedSearch, enhancedAnswer } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ // Won't throw errors, returns empty results array if there's a problem
+ const safeResults = await enhancedSearch("quantum computing");
+ 
+ // Provides a fallback answer if there's an error
+ const safeAnswer = await enhancedAnswer("What is quantum entanglement?");
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Constants and Configuration
+ 
+ The library provides useful constants for common configurations:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import {
+   ACADEMIC_DOMAINS,
+   NEWS_DOMAINS,
+   TECH_DOMAINS,
+   SEARCH_CATEGORIES,
+   DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONFIG
+ } from "@/lib/exa";
+ 
+ // Use predefined domain lists
+ const results = await search("artificial intelligence", {
+   includeDomains: ACADEMIC_DOMAINS,
+   ...DEFAULT_RESEARCH_CONFIG
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## API Reference
+ 
+ See the JSDoc comments in the source code for detailed API documentation.
+ 
```

</details>

I've implemented the four core Exa SDK methods and added several enhancements following the same pattern as the firecrawl library. Here's what I've created:

1. `client.ts` - Initializes the Exa client (was already set up)
2. `types.ts` - Comprehensive TypeScript types for all Exa SDK methods and responses
3. `api.ts` - Core API functions that implement the four main Exa methods:
   - `search` & `searchAndContents` - Find relevant web content
   - `findSimilar` & `findSimilarAndContents` - Discover similar content
   - `getContents` - Extract content from URLs
   - `answer` & `streamAnswer` - Generate answers with citations

4. `search.ts` - Specialized search functions built on top of the core API:
   - `researchSearch` - Optimized for research queries
   - `academicSearch` - For academic papers with date filtering
   - `findRelatedContent` - Enhanced similar content discovery
   - `newsSearch` - Recent news filtering
   - `continuationSearch` - Find content that follows from existing text
   - `phraseFilteredSearch` - Search with required phrases

5. `constants.ts` - Reusable constants and configurations
6. `index.ts` - Exports everything from the library
7. `README.md` - Documentation and usage examples

The implementation follows the same separation of concerns as the firecrawl library:
- Core SDK functions in api.ts
- Project-specific enhancements in search.ts
- Clean type definitions and exports

All four Exa SDK methods have been implemented with proper TypeScript typing, JSDoc comments, and error handling.
